pattern.title: Seating Arrangement
pattern.description: Seating puzzles. Use sets for shared stimulus.

sets.title: Row of 6 friends - Diwali dinner in Pune
sets.text:
6 friends - Bhavna, Esha, Manoj, Naveen, Swati, Vikram - sit in a row. All of them face north, so a person's left is towards the west end (the left end of the row).

Conditions:
1. Manoj sits to the immediate left of Esha.
2. Naveen sits second from the left end.
3. Exactly two persons sit between Swati and Vikram.
4. Bhavna and Swati are immediate neighbours.
